subject: Clarify: penetration test timing, vendor creds, and evidence handoff
messages:
From: Sara Liu <security@fintrak.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: pen-tests@secureassure.io
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test recency / vendor qualification questions

Hi Vanessa,

We're finalizing our vendor questionnaire and need a couple of clarifications before we complete our vendor assessment for Redwood:

1) Pen test cadence — We note you have a recent assessment, but our procurement requires either an assessment within 12 months or an attest from the vendor confirming a scheduled retest. What is Redwood's cadence and do you commit to re-testing within 12 months of the last report?

2) Firm credentials — Do you accept third-party pen test firms that follow OSSTMM/OWASP Mobile + API testing standards? Can you provide the firm name, scope overview, and whether the report contains supporting exploit workpapers?

3) Report age / redaction — Our security team restricts sharing full exploit details. Are you able to provide a redacted report and an evidence package (workpapers, remediation tracker) to satisfy FinTrak's GRC team? If so, how is PII handled in evidence handoff?

4) Remediation windows — What's the typical SLA from finding to remediation confirmation for medium/high findings? We want to align on expected timelines for shared remediation evidence.

Please send whatever you can by EOD Friday; if useful we can hop on a short call.

Thanks,
Sara Liu
Information Security Manager
FinTrak Inc.

[Attachment: fintrak-questionnaire-excerpt.pdf (PDF)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <security@fintrak.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test recency / vendor qualification questions

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and we can expand on a call if helpful.

1) Cadence: Redwood executes a full external + API-focused pen test annually as a baseline. We ran the last full engagement on 2026-05-12 and plan the next no later than 2027-05-12. For customers who require tighter windows we offer a retest/review on request (can be scoped as light retest of remediated items).

2) Firm & methodology: We engaged SecureAssure (a third-party firm) for the 2026 test. Their scope followed OWASP Top 10 + targeted API fuzzing and authenticated session tests; they adhere to OSSTMM principles for test validation. The firm provided a findings report plus workpapers for remediation verification.

3) Report sharing & redaction: We can provide a customer-facing redacted report and a controlled evidence package (workpapers, screenshots, remediation confirmations). PII is removed from any shared artifacts; sensitive exploit steps are redacted at the request of the customer and the vendor when required. We deliver evidence via a secure shared Drive link and can add an NDA or data handling addendum if needed.

4) Remediation timelines: Typical internal SLA is 30 days for high findings (critical/high triage) and 60–90 days for medium; we also provide interim mitigations and tracking notes. For customer-validated remediation we send a remediation report + test verification notes once engineering confirms fixes.

I'll attach a SOC 2 extract and the proposed scope document for the retest. Karthik and Mina are looped in for technical and legal Qs.

Next steps: If it works for you, let's schedule a 30-min call next week to walk FinTrak's GRC through the redacted report and evidence handoff process. What times work?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_soc2-extract.pdf (PDF), proposed-pt-scope.pdf (PDF)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <security@fintrak.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test recency / vendor qualification questions

Sara — Karthik from Security here. A couple of technical clarifications to help your GRC team: 

- The 2026 engagement included authenticated API fuzzing against staging and a small set of production read-only endpoints; no destructive testing on prod.
- Workpapers include request/response captures with redacted tokens, PoC screenshots, and remediation verification steps. We can provide hashes for any screenshots if you need integrity checks.
- For medium findings we typically include an owner, jira ticket link, and remediation ETA in the tracker; for any high/critical items we expedite a hotfix and issue a retest confirmation once fixed.

If FinTrak requires the full, non-redacted report for an internal audit we can discuss a limited-scope vault transfer under an NDA. Otherwise, the combination of a redacted report + workpapers has been acceptable for most customers.

Happy to join the call — suggest Tue 4 Aug 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 5 Aug 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Liu <security@fintrak.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: pen-tests@secureassure.io
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test recency / vendor qualification questions

Thanks, Vanessa and Karthik — that helps a lot. FinTrak is comfortable with a redacted report + workpapers so long as: 

- The redaction preserves finding severity, impacted endpoints, and a high-level exploit narrative (no PoC steps).
- Workpapers include at least one example request/response capture per finding with identifiable timestamps (redacted tokens are fine).
- We get a remediation tracker showing owner and Jira references for medium/high items and a confirmation retest note for any high issues.

We'd like to take the Tue 4 Aug 10:00 PT slot. Can SecureAssure join briefly to confirm the scope and evidence format? If SecureAssure can send a short one-page methodology note ahead of the call that would be ideal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — see you on the call.

Sara Liu
Information Security Manager
FinTrak Inc.

[Calendar: FinTrak x Redwood — Pen Test evidence & scope review (2026-08-04 10:00 PT)]
